free_tier.stated: free dynamic DNS subdomains under freemyip.com, with no login, no ads and no expiration date stated on the home page; any subdomain of the name returns the same address

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no count of subdomains per user or per address is published on the pages read

retention.stated: the subdomain can be kept as long as wanted if the address is updated at least once a year, even with the same address; a deleted subdomain cannot be created again for 12 months

interface_detail: one HTTPS GET to /update with token and domain parameters sets the address; optional parameters set an IPv4 or IPv6 address (myip), a TXT record (txt, also applied to every subdomain of the name), a verbose reply (verbose) or a delete (delete); the reply is the text OK or ERROR with HTTP status 200
tooling: curl, a browser, a router or any scheduler that can request a URL
chaining: a free name with a TXT parameter that the help page says also works for any subdomain of the name, so a DNS-01 challenge record can be set by inference; a CNAME or DNAME from the user's own domain can point at it; the zone is the vendor's, so it cannot be a Cloudflare zone

limits.value: the address must be updated at least once a year, even when it has not changed, to keep the subdomain

binding_note: the yearly update is the only stated limit; the count of names is unverified; no sign-up is asked, so the token returned at creation is the only handle, and the zone is the vendor's

identity_cost.detail: no login is required, according to the home page; the update URL carries a token and a domain, and the creation flow itself was not run

reliability_note: an update with a token that does not exist returns HTTP 200 with the body 'ERROR' and a line naming the token, so a status-only check reports success on a failed update; the suffix is on the Public Suffix List, so the TLS limit counts per name
confidence_note: the update endpoint was called with a token that does not exist and answered 200 with an ERROR body, which proves the endpoint and the failure shape; the home and help pages were read and quoted; the creation flow was not run, because it makes a name

evidence.proved: the update endpoint answers HTTP 200 to a request with a token that does not exist
the body of that 200 is the word ERROR, followed by a line naming the missing token
free dynamic DNS with no login

notes: The only anonymous name in this set: no login, a token and a yearly update. The vendor's clock binds, not an owner's consent: a name lapses when the address is not updated for a year. The zone is the vendor's. The TLS limit does not bind, because the suffix is listed.
